items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I've heard Eubie Blake say more than once that he was playing on the organ in his house and his mother said, don't play that rag in my house. And he said that was the first time that he'd ever heard the word.

ctx.x: That's fantastic. And Lee Whipper (Dr. Ripley) is 96. And the only thing that slows him down, I've just talked to him today, the actor, and the only thing that slows him down is his eyesight and that doesn't slow him down too much. But I've really learned a great deal about them.
